Hero.title: Corentin Juste
Hero.bioParagraph1: I graduated from ESILV as an engineer specialising in Data & AI, and I’m now in the final year of the IASD Master’s (AI, Systems, Data) at Université Paris Dauphine-PSL.
Hero.bioParagraph2: Alongside my studies, I work as a Solution Engineer at ChapsVision on ArgonOS, a large-scale data processing platform used by public and private organisations. I deploy it at client sites, build ETL and AI components, and provide technical support throughout client projects.
Hero.bioParagraph3: Before that, I spent two years at CCF as an apprentice Data Scientist, measuring the causal impact of CRM campaigns and classifying banking transactions with NLP.

experiences.title: Solution Engineer
experiences.preview: Deploying, configuring and extending ArgonOS, a sovereign platform for large-scale data processing.
experiences.role: As part of the team behind ArgonOS, ChapsVision’s flagship product, I work on deploying the platform in client environments and on its technical development. ArgonOS enables analysts, data scientists and investigators to exploit large volumes of structured and unstructured data, for both government and private-sector needs.
responsibilities: Deploying and configuring ArgonOS in client environments (on-premise, including air-gapped, and cloud)
Developing ETL components of the platform (Python, FastAPI), with a focus on its AI capabilities (machine learning, deep learning, NLP)
Deploying internal components and monitoring their health (Docker, Kubernetes), extending the monitoring stack (ElasticSearch, Grafana)
Analysing clients’ technical needs, translating them into specifications, and carrying out integration and acceptance testing
Writing technical documentation and taking part in client demos and POCs

experiences.title: Data Scientist
experiences.preview: Measured CRM campaigns' performance and detected flows to crypto platforms using NLP.
experiences.role: As part of the CCF Data team, I worked on two main areas: evaluating the true impact of CRM campaigns on customer behavior, and detecting financial flows to cryptocurrency platforms for regulatory compliance (KYC) purposes.
responsibilities: Designed a causal inference methodology to evaluate CRM campaigns, addressing the absence of control groups in campaign targeting
Built monthly synthetic control groups using Propensity Score Matching (PSM) to reconstruct counterfactuals and isolate the campaigns’ incremental impact
Developed a Power BI dashboard to monitor post-campaign customer behavior (subscriptions, incoming/outgoing financial flows over a two-month period)
Developed an NLP-based classification pipeline on banking transaction labels to identify flows to cryptocurrency platforms
Contributed to regulatory compliance and customer due diligence (KYC) initiatives
accomplishments: Delivered the first reliable measurement of CRM campaigns’ incremental impact at CCF, enabling a clear distinction between generated revenue and natural customer behavior trends
Deployed a production-ready NLP model for classifying banking transactions

experiences.title: Data Analyst
experiences.preview: Designed and deployed a Qlik Sense dashboard to monitor IT support activity within the Information Systems department.
experiences.role: As part of the IT application support team, working closely with business teams, I designed and developed an operational monitoring tool to track service quality in real time and identify bottlenecks in request handling.
responsibilities: Designed and developed a Qlik Sense dashboard to monitor support activity
Tracked key operational KPIs, including response rate, resolution time, and resolution rate based on ticket criticality
Identified bottlenecks in support request processing
accomplishments: Delivered a tool enabling the team to monitor service quality in real time, adopted for daily operational tracking of support activity
